paper.title_en: Joint Angular-Power Distributions of Interfering Nanohertz Gravitational Waves
paper.abstract_en: Finite populations of supermassive black-hole binaries produce fluctuations in both gravitational-wave power and pulsar timing correlations. We characterize the realization-dependent, orientation-averaged Earth-term angular correlation through its frequency-resolved Legendre coefficients. A hybrid model of bright sources and a Gaussian faint background extends the conditional Gamma distribution in the many-weak-source limit to non-central $χ^2$ statistics, yielding correlated multipoles after population marginalization. Our analytical variance decomposition and SMBHB population simulations reveal a population-dependent transition from interference dominated variance at low frequencies to population-power-dominated variance at high frequencies. In the many-weak-source regime, a multivariate lognormal approximation captures the main features of the joint distribution using only the first two log-cumulants. These results provide statistical benchmarks for fluctuations in both the overall amplitude and angular structure of the realized correlation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接针对纳赫兹引力波脉冲星计时观测中的角相关统计涨落，引入频率分辨的勒让德系数、非中心χ²统计与多变量对数正态近似，并提供解析方差分解与SMBHB族群模拟基准，与PTA主题高度契合，理论深度与方法学信号较强，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 干涉纳赫兹引力波的联合角-功率分布
decision.abstract_zh: 有限数量的超大质量黑洞双星族群会在引力波功率和脉冲星计时相关性两方面产生涨落。我们通过频率分辨的勒让德系数来刻画依赖于实现、方向平均后的地球项角相关。一个由亮源和高斯微弱背景组成的混合模型，将多弱源极限下的条件Gamma分布推广到非中心$\chi^2$统计，并在族群边际化后给出相关联的多极矩。我们的解析方差分解与SMBHB族群模拟揭示了一个依赖于族群的转变：在低频处由干涉主导方差，在高频处由族群功率主导方差。在多弱源情形下，多变量对数正态近似仅用前两个对数累积量就能捕捉联合分布的主要特征。这些结果为实际实现的角相关在整体振幅和角结构两方面的涨落提供了统计基准。
